notes: Pricing is driven by monthly churned revenue. Only Starter shows an amount ('$250 per month billed yearly', for less than $5k/mo churn volume); the monthly-billed Starter price is not displayed although the FAQ says month-to-month options exist. Core has a 'Start 14-day Trial' button but no displayed price (annotated [null], custom/unknown); Intelligence is 'Get a Pricing Quote' and Enterprise 'Custom Quote'. 'Free Churn Metrics' is a free tool, not a plan; the open-source SDK and MCP server are free on every plan, not plans. 'Shared Slack Channel Over $1k/mo' is a plan-comparison condition, not a price. 'Stripe Preferred Partner' describes Churnkey's Stripe partnership, not an affiliate/partner business model: eligible. The headline metrics ('~54% of customers', '$300 million in revenue', '72% Recovered payments') and the 'Churnkey, Inc.' copyright are company claims; no country, founding year or headcount is stated. The 'For Agents / llms.txt' menu entries and the MCP sections describe product features; no instruction aimed at an AI reader was found. The docs page (Data API) contains example payloads (planPrice 1299, emails) that are API samples, not Churnkey prices.
